title: StackConfig
description: Stack configuration: which adapter fills each port, per profile. Layers: infra, llm, cache, harness, knowledge, tool, identity, guardrail, interface, telemetry, eval.

adapter.description: Adapter name; resolved from the registry or the package @agent-layers/adapter-<name>.

stages.description: Guardrails only: stages this guard runs at.

adapter.description: Adapter name; resolved from the registry or the package @agent-layers/adapter-<name>.

stages.description: Guardrails only: stages this guard runs at.

layers.description: One entry per slot; each slot fills one port.

services.description: Extra services for the deploy slot.

layersOverlay.description: Only the slots that differ from the extended profile; null removes a slot.

services.description: Extra services for the deploy slot.

risk.description: Risk values; a core value (read, write, exec) also matches the values added like it.

authenticated.description: true: any verified caller; false: only an anonymous caller.

k.description: Passages injected per model call, and the default k of the search tools; default 4.

maxChars.description: Size of the injected knowledge block (chars); default 4000.

maxK.description: Largest k a model may ask the knowledge search tools for; default 20.

mode.description: system/user: inject before model calls; tools: expose as tools; off.

fusion.description: How passages from several sources are merged before injection.

method.description: rrf (default): reciprocal rank fusion; raw: sort by the sources' own scores (only for sources that share one scorer).

rrfK.description: Rank constant of reciprocal rank fusion; default 60.

additionalProperties.description: Weight of a source in the fusion; default 1.

cacheTtlMs.description: Lifetime of cached model answers (ms); default: the cache adapter's TTL.

approvalTimeoutMs.description: How long a tool call waits for a human approval; 0 does not wait (ms); default 0.

gateway.description: Network host of the stack (agent-layers gateway).

inbound.description: Channel and trigger instance names to mount; every mountable one when omitted.

anonymous.description: Accept requests without a credential (default false).

maxBodyBytes.description: Largest accepted request body (413 above) (bytes); default 1048576; "unbounded" disables it.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Time limit of one request, streams included (504) (ms); default 300000; "unbounded" disables it.

headersTimeoutMs.description: Time a client has to send the request headers (ms); default 30000; "unbounded" disables it.

bodyTimeoutMs.description: Time a client has to send the whole request; capped by requestTimeoutMs (ms); default 120000; "unbounded" disables it.

closeGraceMs.description: How long shutdown waits for requests and trigger runs in flight (ms); default 10000.

corsMaxAgeS.description: How long browsers may cache a CORS preflight answer (s); default 600.

maxRequestIdChars.description: Longest X-Request-Id kept from the caller; longer ones are replaced (chars); default 64.

allowedOrigins.description: Origins accepted besides the gateway's own; other Origin headers get 403.

allowedHosts.description: Accepted Host names (name or name:port); default: loopback names when bound to loopback.

limits.description: Limits that belong to no single layer. Gateway limits are in `gateway`, pipeline limits in `pipeline`, adapter limits in their options.

check.description: agent-layers check: time limits of the conformance probes.

timeoutMs.description: Time limit of one conformance probe (ms); default 30000.

deployTimeoutMs.description: Time limit of the deploy probes (up, down) (ms); default 300000.

listToolsTimeoutMs.description: Time limit of listing tools to find a probe audience (ms); default 5000.

extBytes.description: Largest ext bag kept on a shape the core passes on; larger ones are dropped with an event (bytes); default 16384.

file.description: Markdown agent file: front matter (model, tools, knowledge, settings) and instructions as body.

vocabularies.description: Values added to extensible vocabularies: { "<vocabulary>": { "add": { "<value>": { "like": "<core value>" } }, "aliases": { "<name>": "<value>" } } }.

layer.description: everything. Core values: infra, llm, cache, harness, knowledge, tool, identity, guardrail, interface, telemetry, eval. Extensible: no.

role.description: Message.role. Core values: system, user, assistant, tool. Extensible: aliases.

part.description: Part.type. Core values: text, media, call, result, reasoning. Extensible: namespaced.

finish.description: ModelReply.finish. Core values: end, limit, tools, refused, other. Extensible: like.

risk.description: ToolSpec.risk, policy rules. Core values: read, write, exec. Extensible: like.

effect.description: policy rules. Core values: allow, ask, deny. Extensible: no.

action.description: AccessQuestion.action. Core values: call. Extensible: like.

stage.description: GuardCheck.stage. Core values: input, output, tool_args, tool_result. Extensible: no.

guardAction.description: GuardVerdict.action. Core values: allow, block, redact. Extensible: no.

guardLabel.description: GuardVerdict.labels. Core values: pii, secret, injection, toxicity, policy, other. Extensible: like.

runStatus.description: RunResult.status. Core values: completed, failed, stopped, waiting. Extensible: no.

stopCode.description: RunResult.reason.code. Core values: guard_block, denied, aborted, timeout, limit, needs_input, needs_auth, rejected, error. Extensible: like.

event.description: RunEvent.type. Core values: run.start, model.reply, tool.call, tool.result, text, run.end. Extensible: namespaced.

callerKind.description: Caller.kind. Core values: user, agent. Extensible: no.

approvalStatus.description: Approval.status. Core values: pending, approved, denied, expired. Extensible: no.

mappingRule.description: One boundary mapping rule; rules run in order.

from.description: JSON Pointer into the source, or a list (for join).

default.description: Value when from is missing or null.

join.description: "union" concatenates lists without duplicates; any other string joins strings.

split.description: Separator that turns a string into a list.

drop.description: JSON Pointer removed from the target.

mappings.description: Boundary mapping rules per adapter instance: <slot> or <slot>.<instance>. A list replaces the adapter's default rules, { "$merge": "append" } adds to them, null removes.
